description:
A self-developed Fused deposition modeling slicing software produced by Creality.

Creality Print is a self-developed Fused deposition modeling slicing software produced by Creality. It’s a practical and easy-to-use tool that can help you remote control and monitor your 3D printer and help print directly from your computer.
1. Added proactive assistance in the AI Edition for explaining non-default settings, recommending support settings, and troubleshooting slicing error codes.

2. Added No Wipe Tower Mode for SPARK i8, prioritizing purging along infill and inner-wall toolpaths to reduce color-change waste.

3. Fixed WAN print-start error XD0114 and incorrect color-change coordinates for CFS-C.

4. Re-enabled automatic mapping for K3 and added the option to enable timelapse from the Send page.

5. Fixed model-specific slicing errors and conflicts between arc fitting and speed smoothing, and improved slicing performance for models with many holes using the Hilbert Curve top surface pattern.

6. Fixed brief incorrect colors in Preview and display issues after slicing models that use color-mixing filaments.

7. Fixed paint-on supports not taking effect in certain model regions.

8. Improved sign-in after initial installation and fixed incorrect navigation to User Filaments when editing system filament presets.

9. Improved button labels in the floating-object dialog during G-code export and the estimated completion time display on the device details page.

10. Restored STL/3MF thumbnail previews and fixed the selection marquee remaining visible in the Measure tool.
